gloss: to knit, to braid, to weave

definitions.explanation: To create fabric by interlocking loops of yarn with needles.
To weave strands together into a pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}む。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手編|てあ}み→手編み：15314_teami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother made me a hand-knitted scarf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I braid my hair into a three-strand plait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧や⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}んで⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When winter came, my grandmother always knitted gloves and socks for the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ひも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三|み}{本|ぼん}⟦{束|たば}ねて→束ねる：13059_tabaneru⟧{編|あ}んだ。

examples.english: If you split bamboo into thin strips and carefully weave them together, you can make a beautiful basket.

notes:
{編|あ}む means to create fabric or patterns by interlocking loops or strands — knitting, crocheting, braiding, or weaving by hand.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [item]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}む

ASPECT (ている):
{編|あ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can mean "is knitting" (action in progress) or "has been knitted" (result), depending on context.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{編|あ}み{物|もの}→編み物：06364_amimono⟧: knitting, knitted item
- ⟦{手編|てあ}み→手編み：15314_teami⟧: hand-knitted
- ⟦{編|あ}み{針|ばり}→編み針：28210_amibari⟧: knitting needle
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧: three-strand braid
- ⟦{編|あ}み{目|め}→編み目：28972_amime⟧: stitch (in knitting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {編|あ}む: to knit, braid (interlocking loops/strands by hand)
- ⟦{織|お}る→織る：04373_oru⟧: to weave (on a loom — different technique)
- ⟦{縫|ぬ}う→縫う：00326_nuu⟧: to sew (with needle and thread)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Knitting (⟦{編|あ}み{物|もの}→編み物：06364_amimono⟧) is a popular hobby in Japan. Hand-knitted scarves and sweaters are classic heartfelt gifts.
